cancellation.quote:
## Cancellation Policy

You may cancel your Subscription Service at any time and for any reason. To cancel, contact patient support at [care@altrx.com](mailto:care@altrx.com) or [+1 607-601-6969](tel:+160****6969) and request cancellation, or cancel through your online account/patient portal (if applicable).

Cancellation requests must be received at least 72 hours prior to your next billing date in order to stop the next charge. If your request is received inside that 72-hour window, your Subscription Service will be charged in accordance with the then-current billing cycle, that charge is non-refundable, and the cancellation will take effect at the start of the subsequent billing cycle.

After cancellation, you will continue to receive the Subscription Services through the end of the then-current paid term. Cancellation does not entitle you to a refund of any amount already paid.

## Multi-Month and Bundled Plans

**MULTI-MONTH AND BUNDLED SUBSCRIPTION PLANS ARE SOLD AS A SINGLE, INDIVISIBLE PURCHASE AND ARE NON-REFUNDABLE IN WHOLE AND IN PART.**

If you purchase a multi-month or bundled plan, you are purchasing the full term at a discounted, bundled rate in exchange for the full-term commitment. No refund or credit will be issued for any unused month, unused service, undelivered or unshipped medication, or remaining portion of the term, and the purchase price will not be prorated or reduced for any reason.

If you cancel a multi-month or bundled plan in a timely manner, the cancellation stops any future renewal of that plan. You retain access to the Subscription Services through the end of the term you purchased, and no portion of the amount paid will be refunded.

## Medical Disqualification

If our healthcare provider determines that you are not clinically eligible for the Subscription Services, your Subscription Service will be canceled and you will be issued a refund for any unused portion of the amount paid for the then-current term. For purposes of this policy, used portions of Subscription Services include costs associated with a live or asynchronous consultation that has taken place; a healthcare provider review of your intake, records, and lab results; issued prescriptions; dispensed or shipped medication; or ordered or performed lab services.

If a medical disqualification occurs, the value of services already rendered will be deducted from your refund, and billing will stop going forward.

eligibility.quote:
GLP-1 receptor agonists are a class of medications originally developed for type 2 diabetes that are also used for weight management in certain patients. The compounded versions available through the altRx membership have not been evaluated for safety, efficacy, or quality. Your provider will evaluate your medical history, current medications, and contraindications (including a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2 syndrome) to determine whether treatment is appropriate for you.

What if I want to pause or cancel?

You may pause or cancel your membership at any time. If you and your provider decide to discontinue GLP-1 treatment, your provider may recommend a tapering schedule. Weight regain after discontinuation is common and your provider can discuss strategies for long-term weight management.

What is included in my membership?

Your altRx membership includes telehealth consultations with a licensed provider, a personalized care plan, prescription fulfillment if appropriate, and shipping. All pricing is displayed in our pricing section.

What is the minimum age to enroll in altRx?

You must be at least 18 years of age to enroll in the altRx membership. GLP-1 medications are not prescribed to individuals under 18 through this platform.

What happens if my BMI falls below 25?

Because GLP-1s for weight management are indicated for obesity or overweight with a related condition, your clinician will reassess and may adjust dosing, shift to maintenance, or pause/discontinue depending on your health goals and risk factors.

Zepbound® is the brand name for tirzepatide manufactured by Eli Lilly, FDA approved specifically for chronic weight management in adults with obesity or overweight with weight-related conditions. Unlike Mounjaro® (approved for diabetes), Zepbound® is formulated and indicated specifically for weight loss.

Zepbound® features a unique dual-action mechanism, activating both GLP-1 and GIP receptors to provide superior appetite control and metabolic support. At altRx, Zepbound® is prescribed through licensed clinicians who create personalized treatment plans with ongoing telehealth support.

The Science Behind Zepbound®

Zepbound®'s dual-receptor mechanism represents the most advanced approach to medical weight management. GLP-1 suppresses appetite, slows gastric emptying, and improves insulin sensitivity. GIP enhances metabolic rate, improves fat utilization, and may reduce fat storage.

The landmark SURMOUNT clinical trial demonstrated exceptional results: participants taking the highest dose (15mg) lost an average of 22.5% of their body weight — the highest efficacy ever seen in a weight loss medication trial. Beyond weight loss, Zepbound® improved cardiovascular risk factors, inflammation markers, and overall metabolic health.

How It Feels to Take Zepbound®

Most users report a dramatic reduction in 'food noise' — the constant mental preoccupation with food and eating. Appetite decreases significantly within the first week, and cravings for high-calorie foods tend to fade. Meals become satisfying with much smaller portions, and the desire to snack virtually disappears for many users.

Initial side effects may include nausea, digestive changes, or mild fatigue — typically resolving within 2–4 weeks. The dual-action mechanism often provides more sustained appetite control throughout the day. Dosing starts at 2.5mg weekly and increases gradually every 4 weeks.

Specifications

**Administration:** Once-weekly subcutaneous injection using pre-filled AutoInjector pen with built-in needle

**Dosing:** Escalates gradually: 2.5mg → 5mg → 7.5mg → 10mg → 12.5mg → 15mg (max), increasing every 4 weeks based on tolerance

**Storage:** Refrigerate unused pens (36–46°F); can be kept at room temperature (up to 86°F) for up to 21 days before first use

**Manufacturer:** Eli Lilly and Company

Each program is overseen by licensed healthcare professionals through convenient telehealth visits, allowing your dose and plan to adjust as you progress. With altRx, you get more than a medication—you get a guided, supportive pathway to lasting results.
